source_class: NRL.com official Finals Week 1 roster and official NRL player profiles
rule: Raw profile facts are preserved separately from MAYHEM inference. Unpublished fields are FIELD_NOT_PUBLISHED. Derived trends identify genuine rounds used and do not establish causation.

players.trend_note: Rounds 23, 24, 26 and 27 show continuous 80-minute fullback deployment. Running metres were 177, 130, 92 and 195; try assists 1, 0, 2 and 2; kicking metres 229, 162, 42 and 44. This establishes position continuity with variable running and kicking production only; no causal explanation is inferred.
players.team_effect: Role-critical fullback baseline enriched; no standalone confidence adjustment.

players.trend_note: Rounds 23, 24, 26 and 27 show four consecutive 80-minute wing appearances, with running metres 259, 197, 156 and 145 and tries 0, 1, 0 and 1. This is evidence of recent position/workload continuity; production variation is descriptive only.
players.team_effect: Starting wing running/scoring baseline enriched; no standalone confidence adjustment.

players.trend_note: Rounds 23-24 were halfback appearances (70 and 80 minutes; 39 and 139 kicking metres), followed by 80-minute centre appearances in Rounds 26-27 with no recorded kicking metres. Running metres across those rounds were 156, 157, 92 and 101. This establishes a verified late-season role transition from halfback to centre and accompanying kicking-burden reduction; no causal performance claim is inferred.
players.team_effect: Starting centre baseline enriched with verified recent halfback-to-centre role transition; treated as role context rather than directional effect.
